text: Dental lessons, quizzes and a 3D tooth atlas… in one app?
This is Dental Expert, a learning app for dental students, teachers and dentists.
Study by course, subject and topic: fifteen subjects and one hundred and twenty topics.
Every topic comes with a presentation, oral questions and a test.
Illustrated lesson slides take you through each topic, step by step.
Presentations are made to view and share on screen.
Explore the tooth in 3D. Separate the layers and turn it around.
Practise with pictures: look at the image, then answer.
Review cards come back at a good moment, to help you remember.
Exam mode adds a timer, and shows your result and mistakes at the end.
Daily practice, levels and badges help you keep going.
Teachers have their own home: groups, lessons, picture practice and the atlas.
Dental Expert. Coming soon, in Uzbek, Russian and English.
